jonny-desktop.task: context-keeper: adopt CLAUDE.md-doc findings - .claude/rules/ scoped-constraint projection, PreToolUse scope_guard (rule arrives before the edit), summary truncation floor, README positioning vs auto memory
jonny-desktop.note: DONE + PUSHED (3 commits). PR #13 now at b6cdc6c. Third commit fixes a real scope-matching bug found by probing rather than assuming: `_norm(scope) in _norm(path)` over-matched, firing `src/` on mysrc/main.py, `hooks/` on webhooks/send.py, `server.py` on test_server.py - 3 false positives in a 7-case table. Dated from v0.6 and was tolerable on PostToolUse (a stray rule after the edit is just noise), but the v0.16 move to PreToolUse made it harmful in a non-obvious way: scope_guard delivers each constraint at most once per session, so a false positive MARKS IT DELIVERED and the file it actually governs never receives it. An over-eager match causes a silent UNDER-delivery. Now matches whole path components - file scope matches the path tail exactly, directory scope needs at least one component after it. Also pinned that the hook and the .claude/rules/ projection agree about coverage, since they are two deliveries of the same rule and a disagreement means one is claiming protection the other does not give. Noticed live in-session when a vanguard `hooks/` constraint fired on a scratchpad file. Recorded con-011-76f8 (enforced_by TestScopeCovers). 412 tests pass, was 395 at the previous commit and 382 at branch start. Next action: review and squash-merge PR #13.
